race.description: Palace Hotel - The Gold Rush Hcp
race.comment: SCIENCE DEGREE (5) led them up after crossing from out wide last start and disappointing, beaten 2.9L.  This is tougher, but he drops in weight now and he can find the front from a good draw. He's better than he showed last start and he can get back to winning ways. TREBLE MAKER (8) won well fresh before tackling a stronger race last start when out to 1400m. Back to this track and trip is a big tick for her chances and the wide draw is no issue. Can storm home over the top to score. TACITO (7) hasn't been able to break through for an extended period, the latest effort a fourth over 1400m at this track after being in the firing line on the bend. Finds an easier assignment and can get the job done. QUEEN OF HAWKS (10) proved too strong two runs ago but couldn't follow that up last time out when ninth over 1000m at Belmont Park. In contention this time. DONT WAIT FOR LUCK (2) can't be left out on his recent form.
